items.title: Frank Foster and Bill Hughes interviewed by Monk Rowe and Michael Woods, Schenectady, New York, March 28, 1995
items.q: The interviewee (Frank Foster) discusses his time with Count Basie and the nickname 'Chief'. Andy Kirk is only mentioned in a biographical note about Bill Hughes ('his first band experience was with Andy Kirk'), not by the interviewee as a personal connection.

ctx.x: “Superchief.” Well he was called Chief long before that album came out.

Yeah, okay. What was it that made, for you guys, the Basie rhythm section such a, just like the thing to strive for, something about the sound of the band. Was there something specific that those guys were doing?
